prs.title: feat(worker): add rate limiter
prs.author: harbormaster
prs.body:
Adds `limiter: { max, durationMs }` to the worker options, so a worker can stay below the limits of a downstream API.

Closes #369

prs.title: Revert "feat(worker): add rate limiter"
prs.author: tidewatcher
prs.body: This reverts #371. Waiting in the poll loop blocks lock renewal, jobs got marked as stalled under load.

prs.title: feat(worker): add rate limiter (reland)
prs.author: harbormaster
prs.body:
Second attempt at #371. The limiter now runs outside the poll loop so lock renewal keeps going. The option is `limiter: { max, perMs }`, `durationMs` read like the job duration in review.

Closes #369

prs.title: chore(queue): deprecate job option timeout in favour of timeoutMs
prs.author: tidewatcher
prs.body: All other durations carry a unit. Both names work, `timeout` logs a warning once.

issues.title: Throttle job processing
issues.body: We call an API that allows 100 requests per minute. It would be great if the worker could stay below that.
